_note: PROSPECTIVE (Expansion 18; owner Q18-12 and Q18-13 decided 2026-10-21, docs/directives/2026-10-21_expansion18_capability_simulations_contracts.md, _courier_booths_known_recipients.md, _courier_contract_interface_pricing.md on staging). Courier booths, regular routes, special deliveries and notarised contracts. EVERY NUMBER BELOW IS AN UNAPPROVED PROVISIONAL DEFAULT for testing and analysis, not a balancing constant (the owner reviews the evidence first).

booths._note: A booth is an existing market stall (World.stalls, STALL system) kept by a villager hired by the existing job rule (Construction.can_hire: an adult out of work or labouring). Placement default: the first free manor stall at the market; each off-map settlement has one booth of its own. Which businesses count as 'major' (owner question Q18-15) is provisional: a trader whose trade buys (NPCBrain.BUYS) and keeps a market stall.

routes._note: Regular routes: a flat fee per load, paid at the booth when booked; the courier leaves every every_days and carries up to load_units a load, at most loads_per_departure loads (the route's cart). UNAPPROVED provisional numbers.

special._note: Special deliveries are negotiated (CON-01-shaped, provisional adapter); the computed work informs the courier's least acceptable fee: carriers' day wage (balance helper_wage) x journey days there and back (the return leg always: to come home, to bring back payment or to deposit proceeds), plus per extra load, per stop, and the notarial fee when the courier also notarises. UNAPPROVED provisional coefficients.

notary._note: Owner Q18-13 and Q18-14 (2026-10-23, docs/directives/2026-10-23_owner_answers_q18_14_16.md): a courier with some Law may act as a notary. The Law skill (skills.json, LAW-SKILL) is the qualification; the level is a PROVISIONAL agent proposal (the owner has not named one): Law 2, which the reeve's lessons alone can reach.

law._note: LAW-SKILL (owner Q18-14): Law starts at 0 for everyone, is raised by witnessing and carrying formal documents and is taught by the clergy or the reeve. UNAPPROVED provisional numbers (agent proposals). witness_xp: a signature given before a notary courier, to the notary who witnesses it; carry_xp: a notarised document brought home, to the courier who carried it (whatever the answer: they did the carrying). teachers: who teaches, as {role: highest Law level they teach}; the reeve and the chapel's preacher (DVW-B3-CHAPEL) teach: a teacher is any villager whose job is listed and who is alive. lesson_xp and lessons_per_day: one lesson of this many experience points, at most this many a game day for a pupil, from one teacher.

contracts._note: Owner Q18-13: ordinary small agreements need no signatures; formal commercial contracts and ownership transfers need every party's signature, given face to face or before a travelling notary. small_value: the most an agreement may be worth to count as small (UNAPPROVED provisional). face_to_face_tiles: how near two parties must stand to sign together.
